## Activity

During January 2024, East City Eye Clinic recorded 213 captures. This provides the activity total for the month and represents the number of image sets submitted through the clinic’s eye screening service. The activity record is reported for the site as a whole and covers the full month.

## Image quality

Of the 213 captures, 4 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.9. These images could not be used for grading, so they were excluded from the assessment of referable findings. The result provides a measure of the proportion of submitted images requiring attention because image quality was insufficient for assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 46 referable results during January 2024. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 5 days. This measure indicates the midpoint of the reporting interval for graded images. Together, the referable result count and the grading lag summarise the month’s clinical review activity at East City Eye Clinic.
